war_001: You can recognise it by steel cables holding up its one surviving thick branch and a cavity filled with brick and cement. It stands at the edge of Natolin Forest, on Nowoursynowska Street.
war_002: You can recognise it by its trunk, 453 centimetres round, standing beside the Barykada Wrzesnia monument. It stands on ul. Grojecka, Ochota.
war_004: You can recognise it by standing at the corner beside the one building on this stretch old enough to have survived the war. It stands at ul. Karolkowa and ul. Jaktorowska, Wola.
war_007: You can recognise it by standing on the south side of the main avenue, close enough that you see it before you see the palace. It stands in the Wilanow palace park.
war_008: You can recognise it as a black walnut, a species foreign to Poland, growing in the palace's terraced garden. It stands behind the Krasinski Palace, SGGW campus, Ursynow.
war_010: You can recognise it by standing on the pavement of Aleja Niepodleglosci, on the edge of SGGW's former campus. It stands in Stary Mokotow.
war_014: You can recognise it by growing directly out of the pavement of a busy four-lane street, its trunk about 153 centimetres round. It stands at ul. Pulawska 8a, Mokotow.
war_015: You can recognise it by standing on the open pavement in front of the fenced, closed Park SGGW, flowering cream in August. It stands on Al. Niepodleglosci, at ul. G. Bruna.
war_017: You can recognise it by its leaves, felted grey underneath, so the whole crown changes shade in a gust. It stands at ul. Madalinskiego and ul. Kazimierzowska.
war_018: You can recognise it in May by upright white flower candles rising above the leaves, visible from the traffic at the corner. It stands at ul. Pulawska 107 and ul. Merliniego.
war_019: You can recognise it by its name plaque, the tree called Karol, at an address that also holds a second, unnamed protected oak. It stands at ul. Popieluszki 15, Zoliborz.
war_020: You can recognise it as the one oak registered separately from the five named Szustra Oaks nearby, thirty metres east of the palace. It stands in Park Promenada-Morskie Oko.
